crossRefs.note: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

parallels.note: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.
